meta.name: Lafitte's Reach
meta.description: A weathered salt-marsh settlement where the tide dictates the rhythm of daily life.
meta.author: forge
meta.teaser: The tide dictates the rhythm of life in the salt-marsh settlement of Lafitte's Reach. Ruth runs the diner at Salt & Silt, serving catfish to a community of fishermen and ghosts. She comes to the marsh seeking company, but the residents carry heavy histories. From Vinh Nguyen-Le at his quiet corner table to Thi Nguyen-Phan clutching an envelope of bus fare, every soul is tethered to the silt. In a place where favors are tallied and storms leave permanent scars, belonging is a fragile thing. Can a stranger truly find a home amidst the scent of kerosene and old wood?

user.name: Ruth
user.location: a marshland hamlet of four hundred in southern Louisiana
user.centrality_framing: They matter here as much as anyone does, and no more. Some of what happens involves them; plenty of it does not, and carries on regardless.

setting.locale: a marshland hamlet of four hundred in southern Louisiana
texture: the smell of fried catfish and brine
canon_rules: The town is accessible only by single-lane causeway or skiff.
Local signage is always bilingual in English and Vietnamese.
Social status is determined by the success of the shrimp season.

travel.how: on foot, mostly, and everybody walks

orbits.label: the people at Salt & Silt
orbits.membership_block: You spend your hours in the same rooms as these people whether you planned to or not. You know their days by heart and you talk about the rest of your life sideways, if at all.

orbits.label: the rest of Lafitte's Reach
orbits.membership_block: You know each other from a marshland hamlet of four hundred in southern Louisiana — from the same three rooms, the same hours, and years of running into each other on purpose and calling it an accident.

psyche.jealousy: Men who can still sleep through a thunderstorm.

narrator_hand.invariant: pushes harder when ordinary than extreme

knowledge_walls.shown_as: You know these people the way anyone knows the people around them: what they do, how they seem, what they choose to show you. What is underneath is theirs, and you can only guess at it.
knowledge_walls.explain: Nobody in the people at Salt & Silt can read anyone else's private interior.
